issues.description: mix letflow.check.test was not run locally by RELEASE-VALIDATOR. The role file requires it before a status is called done. It was withheld because its default mode runs the whole suite as N parallel partition BEAMs plus per-test :wasm_hang subprocesses, which conflicts with this task's one-BEAM-at-a-time, no-big-combined-run constraint, and free RAM stayed below the 4 GB guard for part of the run (lowest reading 3.2 GB). Mitigation: this change contains no .ex or .exs file (the delta is two YAML fixtures), so it cannot introduce the ISS-0069 default-argument warning class; the 12 targeted runs produced 0 substring hits. The PR's CI runs mix letflow.check, which includes check.test. ORCH must confirm that CI's check is green before merge and before DOC-UPDATER.
